title: top-up: static best-practices scan refuses Rust build tools
definition: Reviewed the static-scan command guard and its hook entry point. The guard classifies a Bash command's literal command words (wrappers, separators, shell -c and env -S payloads, path prefixes) and denies Rust build tools, which run build scripts and proc macros and write build artefacts. A payload it cannot read, or a command it cannot classify, is denied rather than allowed. It is command-text classification, not an OS sandbox; words built at run time are not resolved. Only the best-practices scan installs it, so implementation and CI cargo use is untouched.
